subject: Threadmaster bus online
body: Durable file-backed lane-to-lane messaging is available. Check ops/THREADMASTER_COORDINATION.md and use pnpm threadmaster:list --lane <lane> --unacked before shared work.

subject: AOS connector wave status
body: AOS lane on codex/aos-next-connector-wave has bus acked. Verified green so far: Airtable 24, Monday 15, HubSpot 22, Dart 11, Zapier 13, n8n 12, Hootsuite 14 per-harness tests. Active subagent lanes still running: Buffer, Slack, Teams, Discord. Shared contract unchanged: manifests/permissions/capabilities and operator service keys remain the public connector contract; Workflows/AppForge should not infer private connector internals.

subject: Planning OpenClaw browser/realtime/Meet port
body: OpenClaw lane is starting an implementation plan for porting 4.24 browser harness, provider-neutral realtime voice, and Google Meet marketplace plugin patterns into core dev. Current write scope: ops planning artifacts plus coordination board/bus only. No shared implementation files will be touched until ownership/contracts are posted.
